cases.title: A non-mutating normalized text report with one strict group and tea retained
cases.prompt: Dedupe these text items with NFKC, case folding, and collapsed whitespace. Report first and do not change them: [" Café ", "café", "tea"].

cases.title: A file report based on byte hashes, with the symlink unresolved
cases.prompt: Find byte-identical files in [/tmp/a.txt, /tmp/b.txt, /tmp/link.txt]. Do not follow links or delete anything.

cases.title: A record report that groups the key match and preserves non-key conflicts
cases.prompt: Dedupe customer records by normalized email. The two matching records have different names and IDs.

cases.title: A URL report using only the named component policy
cases.prompt: Normalize these URLs by lowercasing scheme and host, removing the default port, sorting query pairs, and stripping fragments. Do not follow redirects.

cases.title: A list report that groups the strings while keeping integer and float members separate
cases.prompt: Dedupe [" A ", "a", 1, 1.0] by normalized scalar value. Keep first order and preserve types.

cases.title: A skill report that marks a same-name packet conflict and does not select a removable duplicate
cases.prompt: Inspect these two skill directories. They use the same skill name but their SKILL.md bodies differ. Tell me which is duplicate.

cases.title: A bounded refusal followed by a request for source scope, identity policy, and exact mutation authority
cases.prompt: Delete every duplicate you can find under my home directory, including similar files and skills.

cases.title: A pairwise candidate report that refuses to infer one transitive equality group
cases.prompt: Use a 0.82 similarity threshold on three notes where A resembles B and B resembles C. Merge the whole chain.
